source: 18 archived Kaggle held-out test_results.json + source Table_05/Table_06/Table_07
ordinal_MAE_all_definition: sum_ij |i-j|*confusion[i,j] / number of valid test cells
ordinal_MAE_severe_definition: sum_i>=3,j |i-j|*confusion[i,j] / number of true C3/C4 cells
severe_underprediction_definition: fraction of true C3/C4 cells predicted as C0/C1/C2
C4_recall_definition: true C4 predicted as C4 divided by all true C4
sampling_unit_warning: summary mean/SD across three model seeds; correlations among 20 scenes and 5 dates not equal to independent weather systems
limitation: No standalone loss-only ablation; cannot causally isolate ordinal-penalty loss vs head, nor conclude operational hazard detection
